title: Sixteen years
logline: Sixteen. The corn. The check for the eighty-page strip arrives the same day: forty dollars. Wood does the arithmetic out loud to the dog and eats the corn.

panels.composition: The garage. Corn. WOOD with an envelope. BARNABY, fourteen, in the bed — the bed's new; he can't do the floor anymore. #1 on the wall. The eighty pages in a stack.

image.prompt: a man at a drafting table with a tray of corn opening an envelope, an old dog in a new bed beneath, a thick stack of comic pages beside him and a yellowed strip on the wall, razor-sharp ink

panels.composition: The check. Forty dollars and no cents. A memo line: 'comic.'

image.prompt: close-up of a small check for forty dollars with the memo line reading comic

panels.composition: Wood, to the dog, corn in one hand, check in the other.

balloons.text: Eighty pages. Forty dollars. Fifty cents a page. Sixteen years. Two-fifty a year. The corn's three dollars. I'm ahead on corn.

image.prompt: a man holding a tray of corn in one hand and a check in the other, doing arithmetic aloud to an old dog, dry

panels.composition: Alone at the long surface. Corn. The dog in the bed. The stack. The check under the corn tray, as a coaster.

image.prompt: a man with his back turned at a long drafting table, a tray of corn resting on a check like a coaster, a stack of pages, an old dog in a bed, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Forty dollars. 'I'm ahead on corn.' The check as a coaster.
